title: [3.0 beta5] Issue with TBR value -Dash
symptom: When there is no overwritten TBR and basal rate is according to profile, the Overview screen shows TBR 0U/H and it is not possible to use CANCEL TBR in ACTIONS tab. In Dash Tab there is no value in TBR, and in Nightscout basal rate is visible as normal rate according to profile settings. When TBR is different it works and can be cancelled, but cancellation leads to TBR 0 U/H, not possible to set own TBR value.
cause: A buggy TBR was set sometime in the last 3 days, likely from an SMS command, and it persists for ~3 days. The issue is related to switching between Dash and Eros pumps after activating a pod.
fix: Wait for the 'bad' TBR to expire (~3 days). The issue was fixed with commit 85178ee19ff628dfe4422409973c6f8ae7b511b5.
